Fresh attributable root/SDK gates and affected consumer/archive smokes passed; the normal cleanup commit is bound to the unchanged reviewed inventory with zero reported correspondence drift. criteria.name: Immutable archive completeness
criteria.acceptance: Every tracked artifact removed by cleanup is individually mapped to its original repository-relative path, exact immutable published ancestor commit, real Git object identity and mode. Its complete original contents remain anonymously publicly retrievable through immutable archive links; no removed artifact is represented only by a summary, truncated copy, branch-relative URL, invented object ID, or unavailable local object.

criteria.name: Original review and result provenance
criteria.acceptance: The complete original correctness40 and quality22 criteria, matrices, and source review records remain verbatim accessible, including failed and superseded results and their attribution. Cleanup documentation distinguishes historical evidence from current cleanup validation and does not relabel, truncate, rescore, or imply approval of the original paid work. Feature, whole-wish, and comparison judgments remain blocked.

criteria.name: Frozen experiment seals
criteria.acceptance: All thirteen frozen consumed experiment seals are identified by exact paths and immutable original identities; candidate retained or archived copies preserve every byte and their original evidence relationships. No refreeze, substituted seal, altered payload, or changed attribution is presented as the original.

criteria.name: Complete current inventory binding
criteria.acceptance: The current inventory binds the exact reviewed candidate through a specified deterministic identity method and complete retained file bytes, Git modes, symlink target bytes, gitlink commit identities, and generated runtime artifacts in scope. It explicitly accounts for deletions and distinguishes tracked, untracked, and generated content. Any metadata exclusions are individually named, minimal, and cannot hide implementation, archived evidence, seals, or runtime changes.

criteria.name: Resolvable archive and documentation links
criteria.acceptance: Archive links and directory links in affected documentation resolve to the intended exact files or directories with correct repository, immutable revision, path encoding, and fragment behavior where applicable. Directory links do not masquerade as raw file downloads, and moved historical material remains discoverable without requiring a local checkout or undocumented private access.

criteria.name: Private-data boundary

Documentation explicitly distinguishes publicly archived tracked artifacts from private or otherwise unavailable evidence, without claiming access, preservation, or validation beyond demonstrated evidence.

criteria.name: Forward-only scope and publication authority
criteria.acceptance: The cleanup is a normal descendant commit retaining the original published HEAD as an ancestor, with no history rewrite or force publication. Changes remain archive/documentation/evidence cleanup rather than source repairs or regrading; original implementation and proof remain preserved. Publication is limited to authorized forward-only cleanup, without main/merge/production install/provider/JEV/refreeze/rescore actions.

criteria.name: Attributable current validation

Evidence identifies the actual commands, outcomes, exact candidate SHA or complete inventory identity, and validation scope; post-validation changes must not invalidate that binding.
